description: This source file defines the NotesRepository class, which implements CRUD operations and search functionalities over a local SQLite database to manage notes in an Android application.

classes.name: NotesRepository
classes.description: Repository class managing CRUD operations and search over notes stored in a SQLite database.

methods.name: getAllNotes
methods.description: Retrieves all notes sorted by update time descending.

methods.name: searchNotes
methods.description: Searches for notes where title or content matches a query string, with escape handling.

methods.name: getNoteById
methods.description: Fetches a note by its unique ID, returns null if not found.

methods.name: insertNote
methods.description: Inserts a new note with title and content, setting the current timestamp.

methods.name: updateNote
methods.description: Updates an existing note identified by ID with new title and content, updating timestamp.

methods.name: deleteNote
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID.

methods.name: readNotesFromCursor
methods.description: Converts a Cursor to a list of Note objects.

methods.name: noteFromCursor
methods.description: Creates a Note object from the current cursor position.
